```python
import calendar
import datetime

def next_billing_date(start: datetime.date, months_ahead: int) -> datetime.date:
    if months_ahead == 0:
        return start
    total_month = start.month - 1 + months_ahead
    year = start.year + total_month // 12
    month = total_month % 12 + 1
    if month <= 0:
        year -= 1
        month += 12
    day = min(start.day, calendar.monthrange(year, month)[1])
    return datetime.date(year, month, day)
```
Note: chose to clamp day to month-end (standard billing behavior); negative `months_ahead` tested but not required by spec.
